--- /dev/null
+++ b/_test_unwrap.py
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+
+import functools
+import inspect
+import asyncio
+
+async def async_func():
+    pass
+
+def sync_func():
+    pass
+
+def wrap(f):
+    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
+        return f(*args, **kwargs)
+    wrapper.__wrapped__ = f
+    return wrapper
+
+def test_unwrap():
+    # Simple
+    assert unwrap_partial(async_func) == async_func
+    
+    # Partial
+    p = functools.partial(async_func)
+    assert unwrap_partial(p) == async_func
+    
+    # Nested partial
+    pp = functools.partial(p)
+    assert unwrap_partial(pp) == async_func
+    
+    # Wrapped
+    w = wrap(async_func)
+    assert unwrap_partial(w) == async_func
+    
+    # Partial of wrapped
+    pw = functools.partial(w)
+    assert unwrap_partial(pw) == async_func
+    
+    # Wrapped of partial
+    wp = wrap(p)
+    assert unwrap_partial(wp) == async_func
+    
+    # Nested everything
+    nested = functools.partial(wrap(functools.partial(async_func)))
+    assert unwrap_partial(nested) == async_func
+
+def unwrap_partial(call):
+    while True:
+        if isinstance(call, functools.partial):
+            call = call.func
+            continue
+        unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(call)
+        if unwrapped is call:
+            break
+        call = unwrapped
+    return call
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_unwrap()
+        print("All tests passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
